nodes.summary: For every prime $p$ and every finite set $X$ of natural numbers that contains $1$ and consists of powers of $p$, there is a finite $p$-group whose set of conjugacy class sizes is exactly $X$. This answers Kourovka Problem 14.77 (Sangroniz) in the affirmative.
nodes.title: Cossey–Hawkes theorem on conjugacy class sizes of p-groups

nodes.summary: The statement that for every prime $p$ and every finite set $X$ of natural numbers that contains $1$ and consists of powers of $p$, there is a finite $p$-group $G$ whose set of conjugacy class sizes $\{|C| : C \text{ a conjugacy class of } G\}$ equals $X$.
nodes.title: Prescribed sets of conjugacy class sizes of finite p-groups (Kourovka 14.77)

nodes.summary: For a group $G$, the number of conjugacy classes $c$ of $G$ such that every conjugacy class of $G$ has size at most the size of $c$. It is meant for finite groups: sizes and counts are taken in $\mathbb{N}$, where an infinite set has size $0$.
nodes.title: Number of conjugacy classes of maximum size

nodes.summary: There exist an odd prime $p$ and a finite $p$-group with exactly $p - 1$ conjugacy classes of maximum size.
nodes.title: Some odd $p$-group has exactly $p - 1$ conjugacy classes of maximum size

nodes.summary: The statement that there exist an odd prime $p$ and a finite $p$-group with exactly $p - 1$ conjugacy classes of maximum size.
nodes.title: Odd $p$-groups with $p - 1$ conjugacy classes of maximum size (Kourovka 14.92)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
